dataset.ground_truth: target-window center pixel coordinates from pairs.csv

patch_creation.reference_policy: input must already be centered; no resize or recentering
patch_creation.target_policy: local search image or explicit SearchBounds; RGB is converted to grayscale

spatial_representation.bit_packing: contiguous mixed-width true bitstream with no per-field byte padding

matching.algorithm: exact dense local sliding-window template search in spatial-code space
matching.hamming_implementation: byte XOR plus popcount lookup table
matching.subpixel: separable parabolic interpolation on the 3x3 cost surface
